title: workflows.registry.json — per-atlas workflow registry per SPEC_workflows_v1
description: Each atlas declares its own multi-stage workflows here. Atlas-core's workflows_registry.js loader validates against this schema + cross-references against cohorts.registry.json and the atlas's layers.registry.json. See atlas-core/docs/SPEC_workflows_v1.md for the full specification.

atlas_id.description: atlas_id this registry belongs to. Must match the parent directory under atlases/. Validated against atlases/_index.json by the loader.

version.description: Semver of the registry shape itself. Compatible additions bump patch; breaking changes bump minor.

workflows.description: Every workflow this atlas owns. workflow_id must be unique within the atlas.

workflow_id.description: Stable slug. Unique within this atlas's workflows.

label.description: Human-readable name surfaced in chrome UI / error messages.

knob_schema_ref.description: Path (relative to atlas root) to the knobs.schema.json that defines this workflow's tunable parameters.

default_knob_hash.description: Either a literal SHA prefix or the sentinel 'auto' (derive from knob_schema_ref defaults).

cohort_id.description: Cohort this workflow operates on. Must be a registered cohort_id (cross-validated against cohorts.registry.json).

reference_id.description: Reference assembly id (e.g. fClaHyb_Gar_LG). Typically matches the cohort's reference_id.

stages.description: Ordered list of pipeline stages. Stages form a DAG via produces/consumes; the order here must respect the topological order.

runners.description: One or more execution drivers (laptop, slurm, cloud, local_test). Atlas chrome exposes 'Rerun on <runner_id>' affordances.

post_run_chain.description: Optional follow-up scripts run after the main pipeline completes.

outputs_root.description: Root directory (relative to atlas root) where the workflow writes its outputs. Tree-layers reference this via outputs_root + relative tree paths.

status_file.description: Path (relative to atlas root) of the status.json this workflow's runners write at end-of-run. See SPEC_workflows_v1 §5 for the status.json shape.

stage_id.description: Stable slug. Unique within this workflow.

script.description: Path (relative to atlas root) to the script that runs this stage.

produces.description: layer_ids this stage emits (may be empty for side-effect/fold stages that transform data in place without registering a new layer_id). Each non-empty entry must be declared in the atlas's layers.registry.json.

consumes.description: layer_ids this stage reads. May be from this atlas's layers.registry.json OR cross-atlas (in which case the cross_atlas_imports resolver enforces the read).

estimated_runtime_min.description: Estimated wall-clock minutes on the canonical runner (typically 'laptop'). Used by chrome to pick rerun affordance language.

runner_id.description: Stable slug. Unique within this workflow's runners. Conventional values: laptop, slurm, cloud, local_test.

script.description: Path (relative to atlas root) to the driver script (.sh/.py/.bat).

preset.description: Free-text preset name surfaced in chrome (e.g. 'focal_only_2cpu_skiplargetargets').
